subject: Discrepancy in the Section 26 51 00 light fixture type between Electrical Detail 2/E502

messages.text: Coordination review turned up a mismatch on the Section 26 51 00 light fixture type between Sheet E-501 and Electrical Detail 2/E502 -- can you confirm which is correct before we release for fabrication? No rush on this -- please respond when convenient. No cost impact is anticipated. This is not holding up any current work. Please respond at your earliest convenience. We don't have a fixed turnaround in mind for this -- it depends on the BIM detailer's next clash pass, which isn't on a set schedule.

Sheet E-501 governs for the Section 26 51 00 light fixture type near XFMR-2; Electrical Detail 2/E502 will be superseded by an updated drawing. No cost impact is anticipated. This is not holding up any current work.
